evidence.reason: The current tip already implements the proposed change: prepareDependencies accepts a snapshot flag, only copies dependencies when snapshot is true, and prepareBaseline checks baselineCache before preparing dependencies, passing snapshot=false on a cached preflight while still validating dependencies. Fixed candidates (includeFinding) still take their own snapshot.
